title: Hayati Pro Max Kiwi Grape Raspberry Nic Salt E-Liquid 10ml
description: Hayati Pro Max Kiwi Grape Raspberry delivers a layered fruit blend that brings together sweet, tart, and juicy notes in bold succession. Kiwi adds a tangy tropical freshness, Grape delivers a smooth burst of fruitiness, and Raspberry cuts through with a gentle berry tartness. Each flavour is distinct yet well-paired, offering a full-flavoured vape that’s rich in contrast and vibrancy. This e-liquid is made with nicotine salts for quicker nicotine delivery and a smoother, more comfortable throat hit. Ideal for MTL (mouth-to-lung) vaping with pod kits and starter devices, its 50VG/50PG ratio ensures a dependable balance of vapour and flavour. This flavour is part of the Hayati Pro Max Nic Salt range, inspired by Hayati’s own bestselling disposable vapes and now reimagined in a longer-lasting 10ml format—available in 10mg and 20mg nicotine strengths.
